name: Bellamy the Chime-maker
conversations: Listen. ... Hear that? No? Me neither. That's the problem.
Leafwind used to sing all day. Every porch, every branch. Now it's so quiet I can hear my own knees.
I tune every chime by ear. Then I wait for the wind to play them. I've been waiting a while.
I tap them myself sometimes, at night. Just so they don't forget what they're for.
The old chimes had a song for the Great Tree. Three notes, rising. Like breathing in.
I can still play it. I just can't remember why it made everyone cry.
